default: Keep ROB disabled. ROB4+load overlap is an explicit development prototype, not a MicroBench speed upgrade.
retained: No additional issue register. ROB replaces legacy WB storage on the experimental path.
Independent ALU/MUL/DIV/LSU completions, completed-result forwarding, ID/EX ALU bypass, full ROB pop/push.

rejected: Initial WAW-until-retirement policy: excessive same-frequency MicroBench stalls.
Moving PC+4 off allocation: slight area reduction but lower legal clock.
Masked-OR per-entry completion mux: worse measured timing than the retained selector; independent completion ports are preserved.
ROB8 as default: almost no test cycle gain relative to ROB4, much worse area and legal frequency.
800 MHz / 67922.568 um2 intermediate netlist: invalid undriven shared fence signal caused pruning; repaired and requalified.
known_limits: Current disabled-path mapping is 680 MHz, frozen committed predecessor is 700 MHz. Do not conflate these netlists.
